examples.arabic: العيلة كانت مبسوطة تاني بعد كده.
examples.english: The family was happy again after that.
examples.transliteration: El 3eila kanet mabsoota tani ba3d keda.

examples.arabic: كل يوم بعد المدرسة، كانوا بيتجمعوا.
examples.english: Every day after school, they gathered.
examples.transliteration: Kol yom ba3d el madrasa, kano beyetgammo3o.
examples.storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends
An Egyptian Cooking Day in Our Home

examples.arabic: بعد ما نرجع البيت، هعمل سلطات فواكه متنوعة وهاشرب فنجان قهوة تاني مع صحباتي وهنتبسط أوي.
examples.english: After we return home, I will make various fruit salads and will drink another cup of coffee with my female friends, and we will enjoy ourselves very much.
examples.transliteration: Baʾd ma nergaʾ el beyt, haʾamel salatat fawakih metnawwaʾa w hashrah fangaan ʾahwa tany maʾa soḥabaty w hanetbaset ʾawy.
examples.storyTitle: An Egyptian Morning: Coffee, Music, and the Market

examples.arabic: بعد كده، رحنا بيت جدنا عشان العيلة كلها بتتجمع هناك.
examples.english: After that, we went to our grandfather's house because the whole family gathers there.
examples.transliteration: baad keda, rohna beyt gedena ashan el ayla kolaha betetgamaa henak.
examples.storyTitle: The Joy of Eid with the Family

examples.arabic: بس بعد كده هو كان زعلان
examples.english: But after that he was sad.
examples.transliteration: bas baad keda howa kan zaalan
